# Vistory
> Visit History

Vistory is a GPS-based historical tourism mobile app for iPhone and Android.

## What Vistory does
When a user physically visits a published historical marker, Vistory can unlock a collectible historical icon and its historical story. Collection credit requires using the app within 25 meters of the marker; a QR can identify a marker but does not grant remote credit.

## Key concepts
- Server-authoritative 25-meter physical-presence collection enforcement
- Verified Markers (institutionally confirmed) and Preview Markers (published while institutional verification is pending)
- Special Memory Spots — user-generated private group markers with two-member confirmation
- Themes — curated marker campaigns by museum, topic, or denomination
- Achievements — Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum across Historical and Local Explorer tracks
- Local Discovery — GPS-proximity markers for local businesses, clearly distinct from historical markers

## The human story
Preview Markers are published historical places whose institutional verification is pending; Preview does not mean the place is fake or invalid. Verified Markers have institutional confirmation from an approved Vistory History Partner.

## Mascot
Scout is the Vistory mascot — an animated version of the logo mark. The logo is simultaneously a historical marker plaque, a map pin, and a smiling face. Scout is witty, warm, and knowledgeable. Named in tribute to the founder's sons, both Eagle Scouts.

## Pricing
- Free: 1 group, 1 theme, all historical markers, all achievements
- Explorer: $4.99/month ($49.99/year) — up to 10 groups, unlimited themes and trips
- Historian: $9.99/month ($99.99/year) — unlimited everything, Special Memory Spots

## Institutional partnerships
Museums, historical societies, and state historic preservation offices partner with Vistory to provide verified marker content. Founding Partners receive permanent free access.

## Local Discovery business tiers
- Basic: $149/year
- Featured: $299/year
- Campaign: $599/year
